decision_question: Run one matched H100 falsifier for exact Gemma 4 31B SGLang BF16 plus FP8-E5M2 KV versus pinned vLLM.

sglang.image_resolution: Docker Registry HEAD, manifest list; layers not pulled

identities.hardware: one NVIDIA H100 SXM 80GB, TP=1, one sequential owner

commands.sglang_primary: python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path google/gemma-4-31B-it --revision b9ea41a2887d8607f594846523f94c6cc75ac8a4 --tokenizer-path google/gemma-4-31B-it --tp-size 1 --dtype bfloat16 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e5m2 --served-model-name google/gemma-4-31B-it --enable-metrics --enable-cache-report --log-requests --context-length 12000 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30000
commands.sglang_10k: same immutable server command; exact single-stream request is 10000 input / 358 output, concurrency 1
commands.vllm_control: vllm serve google/gemma-4-31B-it --revision b9ea41a2887d8607f594846523f94c6cc75ac8a4 --tokenizer google/gemma-4-31B-it --tensor-parallel-size 1 --dtype bfloat16 --served-model-name google/gemma-4-31B-it --max-model-len 12000 --enable-metrics --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30000

arms.name: sglang_primary
arms.concurrency: campaign saturation ladder; preserve simultaneous requests

arms.name: matched_vllm_control
arms.concurrency: same primary ladder and request bytes

measurement_contract.quality_boundary: raw serialized responses, request IDs, token IDs where available, exact prompt/template/stop identity; no caller-supplied pass boolean
measurement_contract.promotion: SGLang sustainable cost/request <= 0.90x matched vLLM, >=1.825 completed requests/s on H100 planning case, no worse raw-output/reliability boundary
measurement_contract.cost_basis: shared committed production planning rate nvidia-h100-sxm = $2.80/GPU-hour from research/factory/data/gpu_prices.json; record actual provider metered rate separately

cleanup_contract: one durable owner, absolute deadline watchdog, retrieve raw artifacts and diagnostics, then authenticated named instance/disk absence verification; typed terminal controls completion

budget.compute: 2 local CPU-hours; no GPU in this packet turn
budget.future_run_exposure: three sequential arms, each <=1200 seconds; provider budget must be separately authorized

typed_precreate_negative_gates: image manifest or amd64 child digest changes or cannot be resolved
model revision, tokenizer, config, or chat-template hashes do not match this packet
exact runtime does not accept fp8_e5m2, Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration, TP=1, or the declared served model name
checkpoint cannot fit on one H100 80GB with declared context and runtime reserve
either workload cannot preserve simultaneous concurrency and complete-request accounting
raw serialized outputs, effective cache-read accounting, or required telemetry cannot be retrieved
matched vLLM control is not the same model revision, tokenizer/template, request bytes, hardware, or seed
quality/reliability boundary is worse or cost gate is missed
scope_limits: No weights, image layers, compilation, CUDA, endpoint, or quality execution performed by this $0 project
